lint.description: Run ruff linter and report issues
lint.template:
Run the ruff linter on the entire project using: uv tool run ruff check .
Report all findings with file paths and line numbers. If there are no issues, confirm the project is clean.

format-check.template:
Check code formatting using: uv tool run ruff format . --check
Report which files would be reformatted. If everything is already formatted correctly, confirm it.

type-check.template:
Run the type checker using: uv tool run --with spotipy --with python-dotenv ty check .
Report all type errors with file paths and line numbers. If there are no issues, confirm the project passes type checking.

run.template:
Run the main project script using: uv run sync_spotify.py
Wait for it to finish, then evaluate the output — check for errors, exceptions, or unexpected results. Summarize what happened and whether the run was successful.

Then repeat the same with the other project scripts:
- uv run analyze_liked_songs.py
- uv run list_all_artists.py
For each: wait for it to finish, evaluate the output, and summarize the result.

check-all.description: Full project check: lint + format + type + run
check-all.template:
Perform a full project check in this exact order:
1. Lint: uv tool run ruff check .
2. Format: uv tool run ruff format . --check
3. Types: uv tool run --with spotipy --with python-dotenv ty check .
4. Run: uv run sync_spotify.py
5. Run: uv run analyze_liked_songs.py
6. Run: uv run list_all_artists.py

Report the result after each step. If a check fails, report the issues and continue to the next step. After all six steps, provide a final summary of the overall project health.
